steps.title: Overview
steps.content: Welcome to your coordination tool! 5 simple steps to organise your perfect day with your team.

steps.title: Step 1: Build your team
steps.content: Add your loved ones and vendors with their contact details in the 'Team' tab. They can then be assigned to tasks.

steps.title: Step 2: Build your schedule
steps.content:
• Add steps with 'Add a step'
• Use AI to generate a schedule automatically
• Drag and drop to reorder

steps.title: Step 3: Assign the tasks
steps.content:
• Click 'Assigned to:' to allocate each task
• Make sure you have created your team first

steps.title: Step 4: Manage documents
steps.content: Upload your key documents if needed (moodboard, quotes, detailed schedule) in the 'Documents' tab.

steps.title: Step 5: Share with your team ⭐
steps.content:
• Click 'Share' to generate a link
• Send the link to your team!
• They will see the schedule in real time, along with contact sheets and automatic updates
